subject: radiology
title: Blocks and neurolysis for pain

steps.tx: Facet joint pain is diagnosed by blocking the small nerves that supply the joint. A **medial branch block** with local anaesthetic tests whether that joint generates the pain. **Dual blocks** on separate occasions confirm the result because a single block often misleads. Proven branches are then burnt by **radiofrequency denervation** for months of relief. Axial neck ache after whiplash suits this pathway when blocks prove the source clearly.
steps.say: Facet pain is diagnosed by blocking the small nerves that supply the joint. A medial branch block tests whether that joint generates pain. Dual blocks confirm the result because single blocks often mislead clinicians. Proven branches are burnt for months of relief, and function is tracked after treatment carefully.

steps.tx: The frontal fluoroscopy shows a fine **needle tip** resting beside the superior articular process of a lumbar vertebra. That point carries the **medial branch** nerve that supplies the facet joint just below it. Local anaesthetic placed here tests whether the **facet joint** generates the axial back pain. A positive block selects the patient for radiofrequency burning of the same nerve later.
steps.say: The fluoroscopy shows a needle tip that rests beside the articular process. That point carries the medial branch nerve to the facet joint. Anaesthetic placed here tests whether the joint generates pain. A positive block selects the patient for radiofrequency burning later during planned follow up.

steps.tx: Epidural steroids bathe an inflamed nerve root without any surgery. A **transforaminal injection** places steroid beside a single angry root under imaging guidance. An **interlaminar route** suits bilateral symptoms from central canal stenosis better. In beds where cord injury would be catastrophic, a **non particulate steroid** is chosen for safety. New weakness with red flag features needs surgery and must never be managed by injection alone.
steps.say: Epidural steroids bathe an inflamed nerve root without any surgery. A transforaminal injection is precise because steroid is placed beside a single root. An interlaminar route is better suited to bilateral symptoms from central stenosis cases. Non particulate steroid is safer near the cord, while weakness with red flags needs surgical assessment urgently.

steps.tx: Sympathetic blocks calm cancer and sympathetically maintained pain syndromes. **Coeliac plexus neurolysis** with alcohol eases pancreatic cancer pain when opioids fail to control it. A **superior hypogastric block** calms pelvic cancer pain that affects bladder and bowel function. A stellate ganglion block can reset sympathetically maintained arm pain after injury. Low blood pressure with diarrhoea follows coeliac treatment and needs fluids and prior warning for patients.
steps.say: Sympathetic blocks calm cancer and sympathetically maintained pain syndromes. Coeliac neurolysis eases pancreatic pain when opioids fail badly. A hypogastric block calms pelvic cancer pain effectively for patients. Low pressure with diarrhoea follows coeliac treatment and needs fluids and clear prior warning before discharge home.

vis.alt: Diagram illustrating needle placement for coeliac plexus neurolysis, superior hypogastric block, and stellate ganglion block to manage sympathetic pain.
vis.caption: Sympathetic blocks and neurolysis for cancer and neuropathic pain

steps.tx: Relief is judged by restored function rather than by pain scores alone. A **pain and function diary** tracks walking and daily activity after each block. Denervation is repeated when nerves regrow and relief fades after months of benefit. **Physiotherapy** alongside the block rebuilds movement that pain had frozen for a long time. Opioid doses fall stepwise as relief holds, which is called **opioid weaning** in follow up.
steps.say: Relief is judged by restored function rather than pain scores alone. A diary tracks walking and activity after each block carefully. Denervation is repeated when nerves regrow and relief fades. Physiotherapy rebuilds frozen movement, while opioid doses fall stepwise as relief holds during follow up care.
